finding.title: Use of Unchecked Return Value
finding.trigger: threadCreate may fail and return nullptr
finding.assumptions: The function does not check if threadCreate returns nullptr, which could lead to a double free or use after free in subsequent lines.

finding.title: Null Pointer Dereference
finding.trigger: If the switch statement hits the default case, switchMenu is called without any checks.
finding.assumptions: The default case is expected to handle all other cases, but if it doesn't, switchMenu might be called with an uninitialized or invalid value.

finding.title: Use of Hardcoded Credentials
finding.trigger: The hardcoded escape sequences and strings could be considered a form of hardcoded credentials if they are used for secret handling.
finding.assumptions: The hardcoded strings and escape sequences are not sensitive in this context, but if they were used for secret handling, this would be a concern.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If initArray involves any system calls or command execution, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The function initArray is assumed to not involve any system calls or command execution, but if it does, this would be a security risk.
